rec.name: Auto-Apply Manual Discount Codes (Customer-Tag Based)
rec.status: Backlog — scoping; reference implementation reportedly exists for client BIG (Focal theme)

what.text: Manually created Shopify discount codes are redeemed automatically, so the shopper does not have to type them in. The code can be applied either to all visitors (flat) or only to customers with specific customer tags. A related requirement is to display the active automatic discount codes to the shopper. The ticket links to an earlier implementation, but the links were not accessible, so the details are unconfirmed.

why.text: Removing manual code entry cuts checkout friction and stops shoppers leaving to hunt for coupons. Tag-based targeting makes the offer feel exclusive (VIP, newsletter or B2B segments), which raises perceived value. Showing the active discount builds reassurance that the shopper is getting the best price.

how.text: Per the comments, the approach is to link the feature to a metaobject that holds the manual discount code or discount link, and to load it before checkout. The ticket says it currently only works via customer tags. A likely build: a metaobject stores the code and the customer tag(s) it applies to. Liquid checks `customer.tags` (or applies to everyone if no tag is set). The code is then applied via Shopify's discount URL (`/discount/CODE`) or a cart/checkout redirect before checkout. A small banner or cart note shows the applied code. Comments warn that this may be hard to port outside the Focal theme because other themes are structured differently, and that it may not be a section at all, just a function connected to a metaobject.

items: Discount code or discount link (from a metaobject)
Targeting mode: all visitors vs. customer-tag-based
Customer tag(s) that qualify for the code
Show or hide the applied-code message
Where the code is applied (before checkout / in cart)

dependencies.text: Metaobject definition for the discount code/link and tag mapping; customer tags must exist and customers must be logged in for tag-based targeting; manually created Shopify discount codes. Reportedly built first in the Focal theme, so porting to other themes needs extra work. The original reference tickets were not accessible, so details are unverified.

items: Support tickets about discount codes not working
